messages:
dmitri: hey - spotted a regression on canary (eu-west) for heatmap panels. initial paint stays at spinner ~2-4s, CPU in renderer shoots to ~70% on client.

sara: repro? timeline? (cc @kevin)

dmitri: repro steps below, running against canary route with prefetched tiles.
```
curl -H "x-canary: true" "https://console.canary.redwood/api/heatmap?range=1h&panel=tiles" -v
# open UI -> heatmap panel -> spinner
```
log snippet:
```
[renderer] loadChunk intl-locale: 120ms
[telemetry] init sampler v2 -> sending batch
[worker] kv-prefetch miss region=eu-west -> fallback cross-region
```

alex: looks like the intl chunk + telemetry warmup are both being loaded during initial render. combined with a cross-region kv-prefetch miss we get blocking main-thread work. I think routing policy change last week bumped prefetch concurrency -> TTL thrash.

kevin: fwiw I pushed telemetry sampler tweak yesterday (reduce sample rate -> more batching) as part of rollout 2026-03-17. Could be causing batch flush logic to hold longer and block worker threads. Reverting in canary is quick if we want.

maya: suggestion: 1) disable telemetry init for canaries via feature-flag 2) lower prefetch concurrency for canary routes 3) lazy-load intl after first paint for heatmaps

sara: agree. Also we should add a per-route quota for prefetch concurrent requests so canary spikes don't thrash KV cache.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-17T21:10:12Z telemetry-sampler-rollout started -> canary: 100 requests/sec -> 20% nodes

dmitri: i'll open a PR to gate telemetry init and revert sampler for canary. also adding quick patch to dev bundle to defer intl load. assigning to @sara for prefetech quota change.

sara: assigned, will add quota config to routing policy -> quota:prefetch=3 per-route. rolling update tomorrow morning.

kevin: I'll create a hotfix revert if we still observe issues after the gating.

maya: add an e2e that asserts first-paint < 400ms for heatmaps in canary. (reacted with :thumbsup:)

dmitri: thanks team, i'll keep logs in the incident gist: https://gists.redwood/heatmap-canary-1719604321
